title: Nvidia's CEO, an Alleged Chinese Spy, and the 11 Days That Shook a Trillion-Dollar Company
description:
In November 2026, Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after reports about his relationship with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive US officials reportedly believe was a Chinese intelligence asset. Eleven days later, Nvidia's board reinstated him.
Proven: Huang admitted an affair, resigned on Nov 12 and was reinstated on Nov 23; the US has investigated Megaspeed since 2024 and the Justice Department leads a criminal probe.
Debated: whether Alice Huang was a spy (the DOJ says it has reached no conclusion; Singapore did not investigate her for espionage; China calls the claims fabricated), and whether Megaspeed's chips reached China's military.
Sources: Nvidia press release (Nov 23, 2026), New York Times, Financial Times, Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, CNBC, NBC News, Reuters.
Animated with code, narration is synthetic. Facts as of Nov 24, 2026.
